text: この　ジムに　きた　から　には　そういう　ポケモンの　おく　ふかさ　タップリ　おしえて　やる！

structure.jp: この　ジムに　きた　から　には
structure.en: now that you've come to this Gym

structure.jp: そういう　ポケモンの　おく　ふかさ
structure.en: how deep that kind of Pokémon is

structure.jp: タップリ　おしえて　やる！

patterns.name: 〜からには
patterns.span: きた　から　には
patterns.explanation: からには after a verb says 'now that this has happened, something naturally follows'. きた から には = 'now that you've come'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb says the speaker does it for someone, in a rough, looking-down tone. おしえて やる = 'I'll teach you'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ swapped in for the final い of a describing word turns it into a thing: 'deep' becomes 'depth'. おくふかさ = 'depth, how deep it is'.
